claim_en: בבהמה ("among the livestock," the covenant's partner-list) — BOTH bets carry a dagesh (doubling dot): SNAPSHOT's raw string holds the prefix-bet and stem-bet each dotted.
והקמתי ("and I will ESTABLISH My covenant") — one old book reads plene with yod; the precise books and the Ramah rule doubly defective. SNAPSHOT: defective, the ruling's side.

אשר אני נתן ("which I am giving") — אשר joined by maqqef (the joining hyphen), "without galgal on the shin and without paseq (the separator bar)": SNAPSHOT's maqqef column joins it (the galgal and paseq layers stay uninstrumented — noted).

source: Minchat Shai on Gen 9:12 (Bereshit Rabbah 35, R. Yudan; Rabbeinu Bachya)
claim_en: לדרת עולם ("for everlasting GENERATIONS") — written DOUBLY DEFECTIVE, no vav in either slot, and the chain reads the missing letters: R. Yudan — "לדרת is written: EXCLUDING two generations, Hezekiah's and the Men of the Great Assembly's" (some add R. Shimon bar Yochai's) — generations of the wholly righteous need no bow; Rabbeinu Bachya — "לדרת defective, and immediately beside it את קשתי ('My bow'): the sign appears only in the deficient generations." SNAPSHOT: the bare three-letter stem locked.

source: Minchat Shai on Gen 9:14 (Sepharad books; Hilleli; vs Zanvuki; Radak)
claim_en: בענני ("when I cloud a cloud") — the Sepharad books and the Hilleli point the first nun with SHEVA ALONE; the Zanvuki copy with sheva-patach; Radak notes the form is "lightened against the custom." SNAPSHOT: sheva alone — the Sepharad/Hilleli camp.
בין אלהים ("between GOD and every living soul") — zaqef qatan ("small upright" pause accent) on the Name. SNAPSHOT agrees.

source: Minchat Shai on Gen 9:17 (Hilleli vs Yerushalmi)
claim_en: הקמתי ("I have established," the covenant's closing seal) — the Hilleli copy defective, the Yerushalmi plene with yod; the precise books and the Bechukotai Masorah rule defective. SNAPSHOT: defective — the frame's opening verb (9:11) and its seal (9:17) spelled identically bare.
